newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 24.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 24.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was a bit over $1.9 billion on Monday, while the low in natural float occurred on Friday at about $550 million.
Transporation float averaged about $50 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $100 million primarily due to fog in Richmond, Virginia.
